title: Started the apprenticeship
description: Four years of Swiss vocational training: school two days a week, code the other three. The fastest way I know to learn how software actually gets built.

title: Internship at 2sic
description: Contributed to a CMS built around the 1-second paradigm, where every interaction has to land in under a second. Learning to work inside a large existing codebase changed how I write my own.

title: Graduated
description: Qualified as a software developer. Four years in, with a stack of projects behind me and a much clearer idea of what I want to build next.

title: Rekrutenschule
description: Eighteen weeks of basic military service. No IDE, no keyboard — and a genuinely useful reset on how I think about discipline and working in a team.

title: Shipped my own SaaS
description: A universal log parser and visualiser for developers, as a desktop app for macOS and Windows. My first product where I own every decision — from the parser core to the pricing page.
